name: Josou Gyaru Bitch Gakuen ~Half Musume Judy no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 女装ギャルビッチ学園 ～ハーフ娘ジュディの誘惑～
source:
Thanks to Asuka and Miyabi, the protagonist is completely captivated by the charm of cross-dressing girls. 
He enjoys having sex with them almost every day.
One day, Miyabi invites him to visit her villa during the upcoming long weekend.
